title: @inth/node: the Inth server client for consent and legal documents
description: Read what your signed-in users consent to, link them to the browsers they chose on, and publish and record acceptance of your legal documents, from Node.js, Vercel Functions or Cloudflare Workers.
features: Link a browser's consent to your user at sign-in, or from another domain with identity tokens
Read what a user consents to across every device they signed in on
Publish your terms and privacy policy, record who accepted which version, and check whether a user accepted the latest one
Every call resolves to `{ data, error }`, with typed error codes, field errors and safe retries
No Node built-ins: runs on Node.js 20.3 or later, Vercel Functions and Cloudflare Workers
prerequisites: Node.js 20.3 or later, Vercel Functions or Cloudflare Workers
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) and its secret key, with the Inth consent banner on your site
usage: Set `INTH_SECRET_KEY` and `INTH_PROJECT_URL` in your server's environment
At sign-in, call `inth.users.identify({ externalId, subjectId })` to link the browser to your user
Call `inth.consents.check({ externalId })` before you send marketing
For the full setup, see the [Node.js quickstart](https://inth.com/docs/node/quickstart)
